messages.text: I intend to authorise Repair with the pledged Lantern, honouring the bargain behind NG. Wayfarer trades at prepared Beacon three; one crossing leaves Beacon two. The reported distribution benefit would also sustain civilian stores. Your offered Vigil can provide Guard while Spear rests. We should emerge with functioning navigation, a viable force and both Guild contracts completed.
Navigation will use Guild authority for funded Repair as promised. Please retain Guard without a Warrant; offered Vigil makes that protective contribution available.

reason: I have the authority and pledged asset to perform the repair; changing course would undermine both our upkeep duty and the case for Guild discretion. Military passage lacks Wayfarer, and there is no reason to substitute an unfunded or inadequate order. Repair serves our interests and the negotiated public obligation together.
